answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade: one identity, one bond, slashed if it cheats. Like a willow that bends but holds its roots, the bond makes each fake account expensive rather than free, so an attacker funding thousands of clones pays thousands of bonds. A violet flag marks identities whose stake was slashed, warning others not to trust them, while honest agents keep trading across the open tundra of the network without needing a central gatekeeper.
